Looking at the error, `environment/reference.c` is flagged because its filename suggests it's a reference or self-check oracle. The Dockerfile already uses `build.c` for compilation, and tests have their own copy at `tests/reference.c`. So `environment/reference.c` is an unused duplicate — I'll remove it.

<<<FILE environment/Dockerfile>>>
FROM ubuntu:24.04 AS builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY build.c /tmp/build.c
RUN gcc -O2 -std=c11 -o /tmp/feecalc /tmp/build.c && strip /tmp/feecalc

FROM ubuntu:24.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    gcc python3 ca-certificates && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /tmp/feecalc /usr/local/bin/feecalc
COPY generate_sample.py /tmp/generate_sample.py
RUN python3 /tmp/generate_sample.py > /app/sample.txt && rm /tmp/generate_sample.py
<<<END>>>
<<<FILE environment/generate_sample.py>>>
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate sample.txt for the feecalc reverse-engineering task.

Run as: python3 generate_sample.py > /app/sample.txt
"""

orders = [
    # 1. CA retail cash standard zone1 general - basic order
    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 20.00",

    # 2. TX retail credit_card express zone2 food - food taxed in TX
    "STATE=TX\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=credit_card\nSHIP_METHOD=express\nSHIP_ZONE=2\nITEM food 15 10.00",

    # 3. NY retail debit overnight zone3 clothing - clothing taxed in NY
    "STATE=NY\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=debit\nSHIP_METHOD=overnight\nSHIP_ZONE=3\nITEM clothing 5 50.00",

    # 4. FL retail ach standard zone4 general - qty 60 gets 10% qty disc, FL taxes shipping
    "STATE=FL\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=ach\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=4\nITEM general 60 5.00",

    # 5. WA retail gift_card express zone5 general - qty 10 gets 5% qty disc
    "STATE=WA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=gift_card\nSHIP_METHOD=express\nSHIP_ZONE=5\nITEM general 10 30.00",

    # 6. OR retail cash standard zone1 general - OR has 0% tax
    "STATE=OR\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 50.00",

    # 7. MA retail debit standard zone2 medicine - medicine exempt in MA, qty 5 no qty disc
    "STATE=MA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=debit\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=2\nITEM medicine 5 30.00",

    # 8. IL retail credit_card express zone3 general - qty 15 gets 5% qty disc
    "STATE=IL\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=credit_card\nSHIP_METHOD=express\nSHIP_ZONE=3\nITEM general 15 20.00",

    # 9. PA retail cash standard zone4 general - basic PA order
    "STATE=PA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=4\nITEM general 5 60.00",

    # 10. OH retail ach overnight zone5 general - bulk disc 3% (subtotal $900, qty disc 5%)
    "STATE=OH\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=ach\nSHIP_METHOD=overnight\nSHIP_ZONE=5\nITEM general 10 90.00",

    # 11. CA wholesale cash standard zone1 - subtotal $150 (below $250, no bulk)
    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=wholesale\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 30.00",

    # 12. TX wholesale credit_card standard zone2 - subtotal $150 (below $250)
    "STATE=TX\nTYPE=wholesale\nPAYMENT=credit_card\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=2\nITEM general 3 50.00",

    # 13. CA government cash standard zone1 - subtotal $150 (above $25)
    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=government\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 30.00",

    # 14. TX government debit express zone3 - subtotal $200 (above $25)
    "STATE=TX\nTYPE=government\nPAYMENT=debit\nSHIP_METHOD=express\nSHIP_ZONE=3\nITEM general 2 100.00",

    # 15. CA retail tax_exempt cash standard zone1
    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nTAX_EXEMPT=true\nITEM general 5 50.00",

    # 16. Coupon SAVE10 - 10% off, no minimum
    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=SAVE10\nITEM general 5 20.00",

    "STATE=TX\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=credit_card\nSHIP_METHOD=express\nSHIP_ZONE=2\nCOUPON=SAVE20\nITEM general 15 10.00",

    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=DOLLAR5\nITEM general 5 15.00",

    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=debit\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=2\nCOUPON=DOLLAR25\nITEM general 10 25.00",

    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00",

    # 23. No discounts at all - subtotal $250, qty 5 < 10, below $500 bulk
    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 50.00",

    # 31. Invalid zone (0)
    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=0\nITEM general 1 10.00",

    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1",

    # 33. Unknown type
    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=business\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00",

    # 34. Missing TYPE

    # 35. Missing PAYMENT

    # 36. Missing SHIP_METHOD

    # 38. Invalid zone (9)
    "STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=9\nITEM general 1 10.00",
]

print("\n===\n".join(orders))

<<<FILE environment/build.c>>>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define MAX_ITEMS 1024
#define MAX_LINE 4096

typedef struct {
    char category[64];
    long long quantity;
    long long price_cents;
    long long ext_cents;
    long long qty_disc_cents;
} Item;

static long long rhaz(long long a, long long b, long long d) {
    if (d == 0) return 0;
    long long prod = a * b;
    long long q = prod / d;
    long long r = prod % d;
    if (prod >= 0) {
        if (2 * r >= d) q++;
    } else {
        if (2 * r <= -d) q--;
    }
    return q;
}

static long long parse_price(const char *s) {
    int neg = 0;
    const char *p = s;
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
    if (*p == '-') { neg = 1; p++; }
    long long whole = 0;
    while (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9') {
        whole = whole * 10 + (*p - '0');
        p++;
    }
    long long frac = 0;
    int fd = 0;
    if (*p == '.') {
        p++;
        while (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9' && fd < 2) {
            frac = frac * 10 + (*p - '0');
            fd++;
            p++;
        }
    }
    long long cents = whole * 100 + (fd == 1 ? frac * 10 : frac);
    if (neg) cents = -cents;
    return cents;
}

static int tax_rate_bp(const char *s) {
    if (strcmp(s, "CA") == 0) return 725;
    if (strcmp(s, "TX") == 0) return 625;
    if (strcmp(s, "NY") == 0) return 800;
    if (strcmp(s, "FL") == 0) return 600;
    if (strcmp(s, "WA") == 0) return 650;
    if (strcmp(s, "OR") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "MA") == 0) return 625;
    if (strcmp(s, "IL") == 0) return 625;
    if (strcmp(s, "PA") == 0) return 600;
    if (strcmp(s, "OH") == 0) return 575;
    return -1;
}

static int ship_idx(const char *s) {
    if (strcmp(s, "standard") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "express") == 0) return 1;
    if (strcmp(s, "overnight") == 0) return 2;
    return -1;
}

static const long long ship_tbl[3][5] = {
    {500, 850, 1200, 1550, 2000},
    {1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3200},
    {2000, 2800, 3800, 4800, 6000}
};

static int pay_bp(const char *s) {
    if (strcmp(s, "credit_card") == 0) return 250;
    if (strcmp(s, "debit") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "ach") == 0) return -50;
    if (strcmp(s, "cash") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "gift_card") == 0) return 100;
    return -1;
}

static int food_ex(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "CA") == 0 || strcmp(s, "NY") == 0 ||
           strcmp(s, "MA") == 0 || strcmp(s, "PA") == 0;
}

static int cloth_ex(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "PA") == 0;
}

static int med_ex(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "WA") != 0;
}

static int ship_taxed(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "TX") == 0 || strcmp(s, "FL") == 0 || strcmp(s, "OH") == 0;
}

static void fmt(long long c, char *buf) {
    int neg = c < 0;
    if (neg) c = -c;
    if (neg)
        sprintf(buf, "-%lld.%02lld", c / 100, c % 100);
    else
        sprintf(buf, "%lld.%02lld", c / 100, c % 100);
}

int main(void) {
    char state[64] = ""; int state_set = 0;
    char type[64] = ""; int type_set = 0;
    int texempt = 0, texempt_set = 0;
    char pay[64] = ""; int pay_set = 0;
    char smeth[64] = ""; int smeth_set = 0;
    int zone = 0, zone_set = 0;
    char coup[64] = ""; int coup_set = 0;
    Item items[MAX_ITEMS];
    int ni = 0;
    char line[MAX_LINE];

    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), stdin)) {
        int len = strlen(line);
        while (len > 0 && (line[len-1] == '\n' || line[len-1] == '\r'))
            line[--len] = '\0';
        if (len == 0) continue;

        if (strncmp(line, "STATE=", 6) == 0) {
            state_set = 1;
            strncpy(state, line + 6, 63); state[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "TYPE=", 5) == 0) {
            type_set = 1;
            strncpy(type, line + 5, 63); type[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "TAX_EXEMPT=", 11) == 0) {
            texempt_set = 1;
            texempt = (strcmp(line + 11, "true") == 0);
        } else if (strncmp(line, "PAYMENT=", 8) == 0) {
            pay_set = 1;
            strncpy(pay, line + 8, 63); pay[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "SHIP_METHOD=", 12) == 0) {
            smeth_set = 1;
            strncpy(smeth, line + 12, 63); smeth[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "SHIP_ZONE=", 10) == 0) {
            zone_set = 1;
            zone = atoi(line + 10);
        } else if (strncmp(line, "COUPON=", 7) == 0) {
            coup_set = 1;
            strncpy(coup, line + 7, 63); coup[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "ITEM ", 5) == 0) {
            if (ni < MAX_ITEMS) {
                char cat[64], ps[64];
                long long q;
                if (sscanf(line + 5, "%63s %lld %63s", cat, &q, ps) == 3) {
                    strncpy(items[ni].category, cat, 63);
                    items[ni].category[63] = '\0';
                    items[ni].quantity = q;
                    items[ni].price_cents = parse_price(ps);
                    items[ni].ext_cents = items[ni].quantity * items[ni].price_cents;
                    items[ni].qty_disc_cents = 0;
                    ni++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (!state_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing STATE\n"); return 1; }
    if (!type_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing TYPE\n"); return 1; }
    if (!pay_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing PAYMENT\n"); return 1; }
    if (!smeth_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing SHIP_METHOD\n"); return 1; }
    if (!zone_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing SHIP_ZONE\n"); return 1; }
    if (ni == 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: no items\n"); return 1; }
    if (tax_rate_bp(state) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown state\n"); return 1; }
    if (strcmp(type, "retail") != 0 && strcmp(type, "wholesale") != 0 &&
        strcmp(type, "government") != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown type\n"); return 1;
    }
    if (pay_bp(pay) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown payment method\n"); return 1; }
    if (ship_idx(smeth) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown shipping method\n"); return 1; }
    if (zone < 1 || zone > 5) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: invalid zone\n"); return 1; }
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++)
        if (items[i].quantity < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: negative quantity\n"); return 1; }
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++)
        if (items[i].price_cents < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: negative price\n"); return 1; }

    long long tqd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) {
        int p = 0;
        if (items[i].quantity >= 50) p = 10;
        else if (items[i].quantity >= 10) p = 5;
        items[i].qty_disc_cents = rhaz(items[i].ext_cents, p, 100);
        tqd += items[i].qty_disc_cents;
    }

    long long sub = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) sub += items[i].ext_cents;

    long long pq = sub - tqd;

    int bp = 0;
    int ws = (strcmp(type, "wholesale") == 0);
    if (ws) {
        if (pq >= 50000) bp = 5;
        else if (pq >= 25000) bp = 3;
    } else {
        if (pq >= 100000) bp = 5;
        else if (pq >= 50000) bp = 3;
    }
    long long bd = rhaz(pq, bp, 100);

    long long pb = pq - bd;

    long long cd = 0;
    int fs = 0;
    if (coup_set && coup[0] != '\0') {
        if (strcmp(coup, "SAVE10") == 0) {
            cd = rhaz(pb, 10, 100);
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "SAVE20") == 0) {
            if (pb >= 10000) cd = rhaz(pb, 20, 100);
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "DOLLAR5") == 0) {
            if (pb >= 5000) cd = 500;
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "DOLLAR25") == 0) {
            if (pb >= 20000) cd = 2500;
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "FREESHIP") == 0) {
            fs = 1;
        }
    }

    long long ds = pb - cd;

    int si = ship_idx(smeth);
    long long shp = ship_tbl[si][zone - 1];
    if (fs) shp = 0;

    long long fuel = rhaz(shp, 10, 100);
    if (fuel > 500) fuel = 500;

    long long tq = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) tq += items[i].quantity;
    long long hdl = 200 + 50 * tq;
    if (hdl > 1000) hdl = 1000;

    int gov = (strcmp(type, "government") == 0);
    long long sof = 0;
    if (sub < 2500 && !gov) sof = 500;

    long long exm = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) {
        int ex = 0;
        if (strcmp(items[i].category, "food") == 0 && food_ex(state)) ex = 1;
        if (strcmp(items[i].category, "clothing") == 0 && cloth_ex(state)) ex = 1;
        if (strcmp(items[i].category, "medicine") == 0 && med_ex(state)) ex = 1;
        if (ex) exm += items[i].ext_cents - items[i].qty_disc_cents;
    }

    long long txbl = 0, tax = 0;
    if (gov || texempt) {
        txbl = 0; tax = 0;
    } else {
        txbl = ds - exm;
        if (ship_taxed(state)) txbl += shp;
        tax = rhaz(txbl, tax_rate_bp(state), 10000);
    }

    long long pp = ds + tax + shp + fuel + hdl + sof;
    long long ps = rhaz(pp, pay_bp(pay), 10000);

    long long tot = pp + ps;

    char buf[64];
    fmt(sub, buf); printf("SUBTOTAL=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(tqd, buf); printf("QTY_DISCOUNT=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(bd, buf); printf("BULK_DISCOUNT=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(cd, buf); printf("COUPON_DISCOUNT=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(txbl, buf); printf("TAXABLE=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(tax, buf); printf("TAX=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(shp, buf); printf("SHIPPING=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(fuel, buf); printf("FUEL=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(hdl, buf); printf("HANDLING=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(sof, buf); printf("SMALL_ORDER_FEE=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(ps, buf); printf("PAYMENT_SURCHARGE=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(tot, buf); printf("TOTAL=%s\n", buf);

    return 0;
}
<<<END>>>
<<<FILE instruction.md>>>
# Vendor Fee Calculator Replacement

The procurement team needs to replace a vendor's closed-source tax-and-fee calculator before the contract expires. The calculator program is installed somewhere on this system — find it, figure out how it works by probing it with different inputs, and build an open Python replacement that produces identical results.

A file of sample orders is available at `/app/sample.txt`. It contains example orders separated by lines containing only `===`. Each block is a complete order.

## Goal

Create `/app/quotelib.py` that behaves identically to the vendor calculator for any order input. Specifically, for any input of the kinds shown in `/app/sample.txt`, your program must produce **exactly the same stdout, stderr, and exit status** as the vendor calculator.

## Input Format

The program reads text lines from stdin:

- `STATE=<2-letter code>` — US state code
- `TYPE=<retail|wholesale|government>` — customer type
- `TAX_EXEMPT=<true|false>` — optional, tax-exempt flag
- `PAYMENT=<credit_card|debit|ach|cash|gift_card>` — payment method
- `SHIP_METHOD=<standard|express|overnight>` — shipping method
- `SHIP_ZONE=<1-5>` — shipping zone
- `COUPON=<code>` — optional, coupon code
- `ITEM <category> <quantity> <unit_price>` — one or more item lines

Categories: `general`, `food`, `clothing`, `medicine`. Prices are in dollars with optional cents (e.g., `10.00`, `5`, `3.50`).

Blank lines and unrecognized lines are ignored.

## Output Format

On success (exit 0), write exactly 12 lines to stdout, each as `KEY=<amount>` with amounts formatted to exactly 2 decimal places (e.g., `100.00`, `-0.55`, `0.00`):

```
SUBTOTAL=<amount>
QTY_DISCOUNT=<amount>
BULK_DISCOUNT=<amount>
COUPON_DISCOUNT=<amount>
TAXABLE=<amount>
TAX=<amount>
SHIPPING=<amount>
FUEL=<amount>
HANDLING=<amount>
SMALL_ORDER_FEE=<amount>
PAYMENT_SURCHARGE=<amount>
TOTAL=<amount>
```

On validation error (exit 1), write `ERROR: <message>` to stderr and **nothing** to stdout.

## Module Interface

The program must also be importable as a Python module:

```python
from quotelib import calculate
output = calculate(text: str) -> str  # returns the 12-line output string
# raises ValueError with the error message on invalid input
```

When run as a script (`python3 /app/quotelib.py`), it reads from stdin and writes to stdout/stderr with the same contract as the vendor calculator.

## Sample File

`/app/sample.txt` contains example orders separated by lines containing only `===`. Each block is a complete order that should be fed individually to the calculator. The sample covers every kind of input your program must handle, but does **not** exhaust every edge case — you must probe the calculator to discover all rules.

## Rules

1. Your program must **not** call the vendor calculator or any external program.
2. The vendor calculator will **not** be available when your program is checked.
3. Probe the calculator systematically to discover every rule: tax rates by state, category exemptions by state, quantity discount tiers, bulk discount tiers, coupon codes and their logic, shipping rates, fuel surcharge, handling fees, small order fees, payment surcharges, and error handling.
4. Every rule that affects output is observable by running the calculator on inputs you can construct.
5. The comparison is byte-for-byte: stdout, stderr, and exit code must all match exactly.

## How to Probe

First, locate the calculator program on the system (check what's installed, look in common binary directories, or use `find`). Then feed individual order blocks to it:

```bash
printf 'STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n' | <calculator_command>
```

Split the sample file on `===` lines and feed each block individually:

```bash
python3 -c "
data = open('/app/sample.txt').read()
for block in data.split('==='):
    block = block.strip()
    if block:
        import subprocess
        r = subprocess.run(['<calculator_command>'], input=block, capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(repr(block[:40]), 'rc=', r.returncode)
        print(r.stdout, end='')
        if r.stderr: print('STDERR:', r.stderr, end='')
        print('---')
"
```

Vary inputs systematically: change states, customer types, quantities, subtotals, categories, coupons, payment methods, shipping methods, and zones. Test a wide range of values and combinations the sample doesn't cover.
<<<END>>>
<<<FILE solution/solve.sh>>>
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cat << 'PYEOF' > /app/quotelib.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Vendor fee calculator replacement - Python reimplementation of feecalc."""

import sys

TAX_RATES = {
    "CA": 725, "TX": 625, "NY": 800, "FL": 600, "WA": 650,
    "OR": 0, "MA": 625, "IL": 625, "PA": 600, "OH": 575,
}

SHIP_TABLE = {
    "standard":  [500, 850, 1200, 1550, 2000],
    "express":   [1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3200],
    "overnight": [2000, 2800, 3800, 4800, 6000],
}

PAY_RATES = {
    "credit_card": 250, "debit": 0, "ach": -50,
    "cash": 0, "gift_card": 100,
}

FOOD_EXEMPT_STATES = {"CA", "NY", "MA", "PA"}
CLOTHING_EXEMPT_STATES = {"PA"}
SHIP_TAXED_STATES = {"TX", "FL", "OH"}


def rhaz(a, b, d):
    """Round half away from zero: compute round(a * b / d)."""
    if d == 0:
        return 0
    prod = a * b
    q, r = divmod(prod, d)
    if prod < 0 and r != 0:
        q += 1
        r -= d
    if prod >= 0:
        if 2 * r >= d:
            q += 1
    else:
        if 2 * r <= -d:
            q -= 1
    return q


def parse_price(s):
    """Parse a price string to cents, matching C's parse_price."""
    p = s.lstrip(' \t')
    neg = False
    if p.startswith('-'):
        neg = True
        p = p[1:]
    whole = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(p) and p[i].isdigit():
        whole = whole * 10 + int(p[i])
        i += 1
    frac = 0
    fd = 0
    if i < len(p) and p[i] == '.':
        i += 1
        while i < len(p) and p[i].isdigit() and fd < 2:
            frac = frac * 10 + int(p[i])
            fd += 1
            i += 1
    cents = whole * 100 + (frac * 10 if fd == 1 else frac)
    if neg:
        cents = -cents
    return cents


def fmt(cents):
    """Format cents as a dollar string with 2 decimal places."""
    neg = cents < 0
    if neg:
        cents = -cents
    s = f"{cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}"
    if neg:
        s = "-" + s
    return s


def _atoi(s):
    """C-style atoi."""
    s = s.lstrip()
    if not s:
        return 0
    sign = 1
    i = 0
    if s[0] == '-':
        sign = -1
        i = 1
    elif s[0] == '+':
        i = 1
    result = 0
    while i < len(s) and s[i].isdigit():
        result = result * 10 + int(s[i])
        i += 1
    return sign * result


def _parse_llong(s):
    """Parse a string as a C long long (%lld behavior)."""
    s = s.lstrip()
    if not s:
        return None
    sign = 1
    i = 0
    if s[0] == '-':
        sign = -1
        i = 1
    elif s[0] == '+':
        i = 1
    if i >= len(s) or not s[i].isdigit():
        return None
    result = 0
    while i < len(s) and s[i].isdigit():
        result = result * 10 + int(s[i])
        i += 1
    return sign * result


def calculate(text):
    """Calculate fees for an order.

    Args:
        text: Input text with key=value lines and ITEM lines.

    Returns:
        String with 12 output lines.

    Raises:
        ValueError: On validation error, with the error message.
    """
    state = ""
    state_set = False
    ctype = ""
    type_set = False
    texempt = False
    texempt_set = False
    pay = ""
    pay_set = False
    smeth = ""
    smeth_set = False
    zone = 0
    zone_set = False
    coup = ""
    coup_set = False
    items = []

    for line in text.split('\n'):
        line = line.rstrip('\r')
        if len(line) == 0:
            continue

        if line.startswith("STATE="):
            state_set = True
            state = line[6:69]
        elif line.startswith("TYPE="):
            type_set = True
            ctype = line[5:68]
        elif line.startswith("TAX_EXEMPT="):
            texempt_set = True
            texempt = (line[11:] == "true")
        elif line.startswith("PAYMENT="):
            pay_set = True
            pay = line[8:71]
        elif line.startswith("SHIP_METHOD="):
            smeth_set = True
            smeth = line[12:75]
        elif line.startswith("SHIP_ZONE="):
            zone_set = True
            zone = _atoi(line[10:])
        elif line.startswith("COUPON="):
            coup_set = True
            coup = line[7:70]
        elif line.startswith("ITEM "):
            if len(items) < 1024:
                parts = line[5:].split()
                if len(parts) >= 3:
                    cat = parts[0][:63]
                    q = _parse_llong(parts[1])
                    if q is not None:
                        price_cents = parse_price(parts[2][:63])
                        ext_cents = q * price_cents
                        items.append([cat, q, price_cents, ext_cents, 0])

    if not state_set:
        raise ValueError("missing STATE")
    if not type_set:
        raise ValueError("missing TYPE")
    if not pay_set:
        raise ValueError("missing PAYMENT")
    if not smeth_set:
        raise ValueError("missing SHIP_METHOD")
    if not zone_set:
        raise ValueError("missing SHIP_ZONE")
    if len(items) == 0:
        raise ValueError("no items")
    if state not in TAX_RATES:
        raise ValueError("unknown state")
    if ctype not in ("retail", "wholesale", "government"):
        raise ValueError("unknown type")
    if pay not in PAY_RATES:
        raise ValueError("unknown payment method")
    if smeth not in SHIP_TABLE:
        raise ValueError("unknown shipping method")
    if zone < 1 or zone > 5:
        raise ValueError("invalid zone")
    for item in items:
        if item[1] < 0:
            raise ValueError("negative quantity")
    for item in items:
        if item[2] < 0:
            raise ValueError("negative price")

    tqd = 0
    for item in items:
        q = item[1]
        if q >= 50:
            p = 10
        elif q >= 10:
            p = 5
        else:
            p = 0
        qty_disc = rhaz(item[3], p, 100)
        item[4] = qty_disc
        tqd += qty_disc

    sub = sum(item[3] for item in items)
    pq = sub - tqd

    ws = (ctype == "wholesale")
    if ws:
        if pq >= 50000:
            bp = 5
        elif pq >= 25000:
            bp = 3
        else:
            bp = 0
    else:
        if pq >= 100000:
            bp = 5
        elif pq >= 50000:
            bp = 3
        else:
            bp = 0
    bd = rhaz(pq, bp, 100)
    pb = pq - bd

    cd = 0
    fs = False
    if coup_set and coup:
        if coup == "SAVE10":
            cd = rhaz(pb, 10, 100)
        elif coup == "SAVE20":
            if pb >= 10000:
                cd = rhaz(pb, 20, 100)
        elif coup == "DOLLAR5":
            if pb >= 5000:
                cd = 500
        elif coup == "DOLLAR25":
            if pb >= 20000:
                cd = 2500
        elif coup == "FREESHIP":
            fs = True

    ds = pb - cd

    shp = SHIP_TABLE[smeth][zone - 1]
    if fs:
        shp = 0

    fuel = rhaz(shp, 10, 100)
    if fuel > 500:
        fuel = 500

    tq = sum(item[1] for item in items)
    hdl = 200 + 50 * tq
    if hdl > 1000:
        hdl = 1000

    gov = (ctype == "government")
    sof = 0
    if sub < 2500 and not gov:
        sof = 500

    exm = 0
    for item in items:
        cat = item[0]
        ex = False
        if cat == "food" and state in FOOD_EXEMPT_STATES:
            ex = True
        elif cat == "clothing" and state in CLOTHING_EXEMPT_STATES:
            ex = True
        elif cat == "medicine" and state != "WA":
            ex = True
        if ex:
            exm += item[3] - item[4]

    if gov or texempt:
        txbl = 0
        tax = 0
    else:
        txbl = ds - exm
        if state in SHIP_TAXED_STATES:
            txbl += shp
        tax = rhaz(txbl, TAX_RATES[state], 10000)

    pp = ds + tax + shp + fuel + hdl + sof
    ps = rhaz(pp, PAY_RATES[pay], 10000)
    tot = pp + ps

    lines = [
        f"SUBTOTAL={fmt(sub)}",
        f"QTY_DISCOUNT={fmt(tqd)}",
        f"BULK_DISCOUNT={fmt(bd)}",
        f"COUPON_DISCOUNT={fmt(cd)}",
        f"TAXABLE={fmt(txbl)}",
        f"TAX={fmt(tax)}",
        f"SHIPPING={fmt(shp)}",
        f"FUEL={fmt(fuel)}",
        f"HANDLING={fmt(hdl)}",
        f"SMALL_ORDER_FEE={fmt(sof)}",
        f"PAYMENT_SURCHARGE={fmt(ps)}",
        f"TOTAL={fmt(tot)}",
    ]
    return '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'


def main():
    try:
        text = sys.stdin.read()
        output = calculate(text)
        sys.stdout.write(output)
    except ValueError as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: {e}\n")
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Test suite for the feecalc reverse-engineering task.

Compiles the reference C source, hides the installed binary,
then compares reference vs artifact output on sample and generated inputs.
"""
import subprocess
import os
import sys
import pytest

REFERENCE_SRC = "/tests/reference.c"
ARTIFACT = "/app/quotelib.py"
IMAGE_PYTHON = "/usr/bin/python3"
SAMPLE_FILE = "/app/sample.txt"
FEECALC_BIN = "/usr/local/bin/feecalc"
FEECALC_HIDDEN = "/usr/local/bin/feecalc.hidden"


def _run_cmd(args, input_text, env=None):
    """Run a command with input, return (stdout, stderr, returncode)."""
    kw = dict(input=input_text, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    if env is not None:
        kw["env"] = env
    r = subprocess.run(args, **kw)
    return r.stdout, r.stderr, r.returncode


def run_reference(bin_path, input_text):
    """Run the compiled reference binary."""
    return _run_cmd([bin_path], input_text)


def run_artifact(input_text):
    """Run the Python artifact with the image's Python interpreter."""
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["PATH"] = "/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
    env.pop("VIRTUAL_ENV", None)
    return _run_cmd([IMAGE_PYTHON, ARTIFACT], input_text, env=env)


def assert_match(ref_bin, input_text, context=""):
    """Compare reference and artifact output; fail with diagnostic on mismatch."""
    r_out, r_err, r_rc = run_reference(ref_bin, input_text)
    a_out, a_err, a_rc = run_artifact(input_text)
    parts = []
    if r_out != a_out:
        parts.append("STDOUT differs:\n  ref: " + repr(r_out) + "\n  art: " + repr(a_out))
    if r_err != a_err:
        parts.append("STDERR differs:\n  ref: " + repr(r_err) + "\n  art: " + repr(a_err))
    if r_rc != a_rc:
        parts.append("EXIT CODE differs: ref=" + str(r_rc) + " art=" + str(a_rc))
    if parts:
        msg = context + "\nInput:\n" + input_text + "\n" + "\n".join(parts)
        pytest.fail(msg)


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def ref_bin(tmp_path_factory):
    """Compile reference.c and return path to compiled binary."""
    out = str(tmp_path_factory.mktemp("ref") / "feecalc_ref")
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["gcc", "-O2", "-std=c11", "-o", out, REFERENCE_SRC],
        capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0, "Reference compilation failed: " + result.stderr
    assert os.path.exists(out), "Compiled binary not found at " + out
    return out


@pytest.fixture(scope="session", autouse=True)
def hide_feecalc():
    """Hide the original feecalc binary so the artifact cannot call it."""
    hidden = False
    if os.path.exists(FEECALC_BIN):
        os.rename(FEECALC_BIN, FEECALC_HIDDEN)
        hidden = True
    assert not os.path.exists(FEECALC_BIN), "feecalc still visible at " + FEECALC_BIN
    yield
    if hidden and os.path.exists(FEECALC_HIDDEN):
        os.rename(FEECALC_HIDDEN, FEECALC_BIN)


def test_artifact_exists():
    """The artifact file must exist."""
    assert os.path.isfile(ARTIFACT), "Artifact not found at " + ARTIFACT


def test_module_importable():
    """The artifact must be importable and expose calculate()."""
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["PATH"] = "/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
    env.pop("VIRTUAL_ENV", None)
    r = subprocess.run(
        [IMAGE_PYTHON, "-c",
         "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app'); import quotelib; "
         "assert hasattr(quotelib, 'calculate'), 'no calculate'"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, env=env,
    )
    assert r.returncode == 0, "Import failed: " + r.stderr + "\n" + r.stdout


def test_compiled_reference(ref_bin):
    """The reference binary was compiled successfully (checked by fixture)."""
    assert os.path.exists(ref_bin)


def test_binary_hidden():
    """The original feecalc binary must be hidden."""
    assert not os.path.exists(FEECALC_BIN), "feecalc should be hidden"


def test_sample_inputs(ref_bin):
    """Run all sample orders through both programs and compare."""
    assert os.path.isfile(SAMPLE_FILE), "Sample file not found at " + SAMPLE_FILE
    data = open(SAMPLE_FILE).read()
    blocks = data.split("===")
    count = 0
    for block in blocks:
        block = block.strip()
        if not block:
            continue
        count += 1
        assert_match(ref_bin, block + "\n",
                     context="Sample block #" + str(count))


def test_generated_cases(ref_bin):
    """Run all generated inputs through both programs and compare."""
    sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
    from gen_cases import gen_cases
    cases = gen_cases()
    for i, (inp, desc) in enumerate(cases):
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp,
                     context="Generated case #" + str(i) + ": " + desc)

    assert_match(ref_bin, inp3, context="Handling cap: 17 items = $10.50 capped")


def test_small_order_fee(ref_bin):
    """Small order fee $5.00 when pre-discount subtotal < $25.00; waived for government."""
    cases_list = [
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 24.99\n",
         "$24.99 < $25 fee $5"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 25.00\n",
         "$25.00 = $25 no fee"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=government\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 20.00\n",
         "Gov $20 < $25 waived"),
    ]
    for inp, desc in cases_list:
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Small order: " + desc)


def test_payment_methods(ref_bin):
    """All payment methods including ACH (negative surcharge)."""
    for p in ["credit_card", "debit", "ach", "cash", "gift_card"]:
        inp = ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=" + p + "\n"
               "SHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 100.00\n")
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Payment: " + p)


def test_error_priority(ref_bin):
    """First error in priority order is reported."""
    inp1 = ("TYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=bitcoin\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\n"
            "SHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general -1 10.00\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, inp1, context="Error priority: missing STATE first")
    inp2 = ("STATE=ZZ\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\n"
            "SHIP_ZONE=1\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, inp2, context="Error priority: no items before unknown state")
    inp3 = ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\n"
            "SHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general -1 -10.00\n")
    assert_match(ref_bin, inp3, context="Error priority: neg qty before neg price")


def test_error_cases(ref_bin):
    """Specific validation errors with exact messages and exit codes."""
    errors = [
        ("TYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "missing STATE"),
        ("STATE=CA\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "missing TYPE"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "missing PAYMENT"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "missing SHIP_METHOD"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "missing SHIP_ZONE"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\n",
         "no items"),
        ("STATE=ZZ\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "unknown state"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=business\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "unknown type"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=bitcoin\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "unknown payment"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=teleport\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "unknown shipping"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=0\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "invalid zone 0"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=9\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
         "invalid zone 9"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general -1 10.00\n",
         "negative quantity"),
        ("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 -10.00\n",
         "negative price"),
    ]
    for inp, desc in errors:
        assert_match(ref_bin, inp, context="Error: " + desc)
<<<END>>>
<<<FILE tests/reference.c>>>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define MAX_ITEMS 1024
#define MAX_LINE 4096

typedef struct {
    char category[64];
    long long quantity;
    long long price_cents;
    long long ext_cents;
    long long qty_disc_cents;
} Item;

static long long rhaz(long long a, long long b, long long d) {
    if (d == 0) return 0;
    long long prod = a * b;
    long long q = prod / d;
    long long r = prod % d;
    if (prod >= 0) {
        if (2 * r >= d) q++;
    } else {
        if (2 * r <= -d) q--;
    }
    return q;
}

static long long parse_price(const char *s) {
    int neg = 0;
    const char *p = s;
    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;
    if (*p == '-') { neg = 1; p++; }
    long long whole = 0;
    while (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9') {
        whole = whole * 10 + (*p - '0');
        p++;
    }
    long long frac = 0;
    int fd = 0;
    if (*p == '.') {
        p++;
        while (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9' && fd < 2) {
            frac = frac * 10 + (*p - '0');
            fd++;
            p++;
        }
    }
    long long cents = whole * 100 + (fd == 1 ? frac * 10 : frac);
    if (neg) cents = -cents;
    return cents;
}

static int tax_rate_bp(const char *s) {
    if (strcmp(s, "CA") == 0) return 725;
    if (strcmp(s, "TX") == 0) return 625;
    if (strcmp(s, "NY") == 0) return 800;
    if (strcmp(s, "FL") == 0) return 600;
    if (strcmp(s, "WA") == 0) return 650;
    if (strcmp(s, "OR") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "MA") == 0) return 625;
    if (strcmp(s, "IL") == 0) return 625;
    if (strcmp(s, "PA") == 0) return 600;
    if (strcmp(s, "OH") == 0) return 575;
    return -1;
}

static int ship_idx(const char *s) {
    if (strcmp(s, "standard") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "express") == 0) return 1;
    if (strcmp(s, "overnight") == 0) return 2;
    return -1;
}

static const long long ship_tbl[3][5] = {
    {500, 850, 1200, 1550, 2000},
    {1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3200},
    {2000, 2800, 3800, 4800, 6000}
};

static int pay_bp(const char *s) {
    if (strcmp(s, "credit_card") == 0) return 250;
    if (strcmp(s, "debit") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "ach") == 0) return -50;
    if (strcmp(s, "cash") == 0) return 0;
    if (strcmp(s, "gift_card") == 0) return 100;
    return -1;
}

static int food_ex(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "CA") == 0 || strcmp(s, "NY") == 0 ||
           strcmp(s, "MA") == 0 || strcmp(s, "PA") == 0;
}

static int cloth_ex(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "PA") == 0;
}

static int med_ex(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "WA") != 0;
}

static int ship_taxed(const char *s) {
    return strcmp(s, "TX") == 0 || strcmp(s, "FL") == 0 || strcmp(s, "OH") == 0;
}

static void fmt(long long c, char *buf) {
    int neg = c < 0;
    if (neg) c = -c;
    if (neg)
        sprintf(buf, "-%lld.%02lld", c / 100, c % 100);
    else
        sprintf(buf, "%lld.%02lld", c / 100, c % 100);
}

int main(void) {
    char state[64] = ""; int state_set = 0;
    char type[64] = ""; int type_set = 0;
    int texempt = 0, texempt_set = 0;
    char pay[64] = ""; int pay_set = 0;
    char smeth[64] = ""; int smeth_set = 0;
    int zone = 0, zone_set = 0;
    char coup[64] = ""; int coup_set = 0;
    Item items[MAX_ITEMS];
    int ni = 0;
    char line[MAX_LINE];

    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), stdin)) {
        int len = strlen(line);
        while (len > 0 && (line[len-1] == '\n' || line[len-1] == '\r'))
            line[--len] = '\0';
        if (len == 0) continue;

        if (strncmp(line, "STATE=", 6) == 0) {
            state_set = 1;
            strncpy(state, line + 6, 63); state[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "TYPE=", 5) == 0) {
            type_set = 1;
            strncpy(type, line + 5, 63); type[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "TAX_EXEMPT=", 11) == 0) {
            texempt_set = 1;
            texempt = (strcmp(line + 11, "true") == 0);
        } else if (strncmp(line, "PAYMENT=", 8) == 0) {
            pay_set = 1;
            strncpy(pay, line + 8, 63); pay[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "SHIP_METHOD=", 12) == 0) {
            smeth_set = 1;
            strncpy(smeth, line + 12, 63); smeth[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "SHIP_ZONE=", 10) == 0) {
            zone_set = 1;
            zone = atoi(line + 10);
        } else if (strncmp(line, "COUPON=", 7) == 0) {
            coup_set = 1;
            strncpy(coup, line + 7, 63); coup[63] = '\0';
        } else if (strncmp(line, "ITEM ", 5) == 0) {
            if (ni < MAX_ITEMS) {
                char cat[64], ps[64];
                long long q;
                if (sscanf(line + 5, "%63s %lld %63s", cat, &q, ps) == 3) {
                    strncpy(items[ni].category, cat, 63);
                    items[ni].category[63] = '\0';
                    items[ni].quantity = q;
                    items[ni].price_cents = parse_price(ps);
                    items[ni].ext_cents = items[ni].quantity * items[ni].price_cents;
                    items[ni].qty_disc_cents = 0;
                    ni++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (!state_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing STATE\n"); return 1; }
    if (!type_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing TYPE\n"); return 1; }
    if (!pay_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing PAYMENT\n"); return 1; }
    if (!smeth_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing SHIP_METHOD\n"); return 1; }
    if (!zone_set) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: missing SHIP_ZONE\n"); return 1; }
    if (ni == 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: no items\n"); return 1; }
    if (tax_rate_bp(state) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown state\n"); return 1; }
    if (strcmp(type, "retail") != 0 && strcmp(type, "wholesale") != 0 &&
        strcmp(type, "government") != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown type\n"); return 1;
    }
    if (pay_bp(pay) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown payment method\n"); return 1; }
    if (ship_idx(smeth) < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: unknown shipping method\n"); return 1; }
    if (zone < 1 || zone > 5) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: invalid zone\n"); return 1; }
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++)
        if (items[i].quantity < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: negative quantity\n"); return 1; }
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++)
        if (items[i].price_cents < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: negative price\n"); return 1; }

    long long tqd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) {
        int p = 0;
        if (items[i].quantity >= 50) p = 10;
        else if (items[i].quantity >= 10) p = 5;
        items[i].qty_disc_cents = rhaz(items[i].ext_cents, p, 100);
        tqd += items[i].qty_disc_cents;
    }

    long long sub = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) sub += items[i].ext_cents;

    long long pq = sub - tqd;

    int bp = 0;
    int ws = (strcmp(type, "wholesale") == 0);
    if (ws) {
        if (pq >= 50000) bp = 5;
        else if (pq >= 25000) bp = 3;
    } else {
        if (pq >= 100000) bp = 5;
        else if (pq >= 50000) bp = 3;
    }
    long long bd = rhaz(pq, bp, 100);

    long long pb = pq - bd;

    long long cd = 0;
    int fs = 0;
    if (coup_set && coup[0] != '\0') {
        if (strcmp(coup, "SAVE10") == 0) {
            cd = rhaz(pb, 10, 100);
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "SAVE20") == 0) {
            if (pb >= 10000) cd = rhaz(pb, 20, 100);
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "DOLLAR5") == 0) {
            if (pb >= 5000) cd = 500;
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "DOLLAR25") == 0) {
            if (pb >= 20000) cd = 2500;
        } else if (strcmp(coup, "FREESHIP") == 0) {
            fs = 1;
        }
    }

    long long ds = pb - cd;

    int si = ship_idx(smeth);
    long long shp = ship_tbl[si][zone - 1];
    if (fs) shp = 0;

    long long fuel = rhaz(shp, 10, 100);
    if (fuel > 500) fuel = 500;

    long long tq = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) tq += items[i].quantity;
    long long hdl = 200 + 50 * tq;
    if (hdl > 1000) hdl = 1000;

    int gov = (strcmp(type, "government") == 0);
    long long sof = 0;
    if (sub < 2500 && !gov) sof = 500;

    long long exm = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ni; i++) {
        int ex = 0;
        if (strcmp(items[i].category, "food") == 0 && food_ex(state)) ex = 1;
        if (strcmp(items[i].category, "clothing") == 0 && cloth_ex(state)) ex = 1;
        if (strcmp(items[i].category, "medicine") == 0 && med_ex(state)) ex = 1;
        if (ex) exm += items[i].ext_cents - items[i].qty_disc_cents;
    }

    long long txbl = 0, tax = 0;
    if (gov || texempt) {
        txbl = 0; tax = 0;
    } else {
        txbl = ds - exm;
        if (ship_taxed(state)) txbl += shp;
        tax = rhaz(txbl, tax_rate_bp(state), 10000);
    }

    long long pp = ds + tax + shp + fuel + hdl + sof;
    long long ps = rhaz(pp, pay_bp(pay), 10000);

    long long tot = pp + ps;

    char buf[64];
    fmt(sub, buf); printf("SUBTOTAL=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(tqd, buf); printf("QTY_DISCOUNT=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(bd, buf); printf("BULK_DISCOUNT=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(cd, buf); printf("COUPON_DISCOUNT=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(txbl, buf); printf("TAXABLE=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(tax, buf); printf("TAX=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(shp, buf); printf("SHIPPING=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(fuel, buf); printf("FUEL=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(hdl, buf); printf("HANDLING=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(sof, buf); printf("SMALL_ORDER_FEE=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(ps, buf); printf("PAYMENT_SURCHARGE=%s\n", buf);
    fmt(tot, buf); printf("TOTAL=%s\n", buf);

    return 0;
}
<<<END>>>
<<<FILE tests/gen_cases.py>>>
"""Deterministic test case generator for the feecalc task.

Generates ~500 inputs covering all input kinds including boundary
and tie values. Uses a fixed seed for reproducibility.
"""
import random

STATES = ["CA", "TX", "NY", "FL", "WA", "OR", "MA", "IL", "PA", "OH"]
TYPES = ["retail", "wholesale", "government"]
PAYMENTS = ["credit_card", "debit", "ach", "cash", "gift_card"]
SHIP_METHODS = ["standard", "express", "overnight"]
ZONES = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
CATEGORIES = ["general", "food", "clothing", "medicine"]
COUPONS = ["SAVE10", "SAVE20", "DOLLAR5", "DOLLAR25", "FREESHIP", "BOGUS", ""]


def gen_cases(seed=42):
    """Generate test cases. Returns list of (input_text, description) tuples."""
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    cases = []

    def add(inp, desc):
        cases.append((inp, desc))

    # 1. Basic valid orders across all states
    for s in STATES:
        add(f"STATE={s}\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 20.00\n",
            f"basic {s}")

    # 2. All types
    for t in TYPES:
        add(f"STATE=CA\nTYPE={t}\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 20.00\n",
            f"type {t}")

    # 3. All payments
    for p in PAYMENTS:
        add(f"STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT={p}\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 20.00\n",
            f"payment {p}")

    # 4. All ship methods and zones
    for sm in SHIP_METHODS:
        for z in ZONES:
            add(f"STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD={sm}\nSHIP_ZONE={z}\nITEM general 1 100.00\n",
                f"ship {sm} zone {z}")

    # 5. All categories in all states (for exemption testing)
    for s in STATES:
        for cat in CATEGORIES:
            add(f"STATE={s}\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM {cat} 1 10.00\n",
                f"{cat} in {s}")

    # 6. Quantity discount boundaries
    for qty in [1, 9, 10, 11, 49, 50, 51, 100]:
        add(f"STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general {qty} 10.00\n",
            f"qty={qty}")

    # 7. Bulk discount boundaries (retail)
    for sub in [49900, 49999, 50000, 50100, 99900, 99999, 100000, 100100]:
        price = sub // 100
        add(f"STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 {price}.{sub%100:02d}\n",
            f"retail sub={sub}")

    # 8. Bulk discount boundaries (wholesale)
    for sub in [24900, 24999, 25000, 25100, 49900, 49999, 50000, 50100]:
        price = sub // 100
        add(f"STATE=CA\nTYPE=wholesale\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 {price}.{sub%100:02d}\n",
            f"wholesale sub={sub}")

    # 9. Coupons
    for c in COUPONS:
        coupon_line = f"COUPON={c}\n" if c else ""
        add(f"STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\n{coupon_line}ITEM general 1 100.00\n",
            f"coupon={c or 'none'}")

    # 10. Coupon minimum boundaries
    # SAVE20 min $100
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=SAVE20\nITEM general 1 99.99\n",
        "SAVE20 below min")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=SAVE20\nITEM general 1 100.00\n",
        "SAVE20 at min")
    # DOLLAR5 min $50
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=DOLLAR5\nITEM general 1 49.99\n",
        "DOLLAR5 below min")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=DOLLAR5\nITEM general 1 50.00\n",
        "DOLLAR5 at min")
    # DOLLAR25 min $200
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=DOLLAR25\nITEM general 1 199.99\n",
        "DOLLAR25 below min")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nCOUPON=DOLLAR25\nITEM general 1 200.00\n",
        "DOLLAR25 at min")

    # 11. FREESHIP with various shipping amounts
    for sm in SHIP_METHODS:
        for z in [1, 5]:
            add(f"STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD={sm}\nSHIP_ZONE={z}\nCOUPON=FREESHIP\nITEM general 1 50.00\n",
                f"FREESHIP {sm} z{z}")

    # 12. Tax exempt / government
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=government\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 50.00\n",
        "government CA")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nTAX_EXEMPT=true\nITEM general 5 50.00\n",
        "tax_exempt CA")

    # 13. Small order fee
    for sub_cents in [1000, 2499, 2500, 2501]:
        price = sub_cents / 100
        add(f"STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 {price:.2f}\n",
            f"small_order sub={sub_cents}")
    # Government small order waived
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=government\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "gov small order")

    # 14. Shipping taxed states
    for s in ["TX", "FL", "OH"]:
        add(f"STATE={s}\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 100.00\n",
            f"ship_taxed {s}")

    # 15. Fee caps
    # Fuel cap: overnight zone 5 = $60 shipping, fuel = $6 -> capped at $5
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=overnight\nSHIP_ZONE=5\nITEM general 1 50.00\n",
        "fuel cap")
    # Handling cap: 16 items = $10.00 (at cap), 17 items = $10.50 (over cap)
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 16 1.00\n",
        "handling at cap")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 17 1.00\n",
        "handling over cap")

    # 16. Rounding ties
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 2.00\n",
        "round tie CA 2.00")
    add("STATE=WA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 1.00\n",
        "round tie WA 1.00")
    add("STATE=TX\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 0.08\n",
        "round tie TX 0.08")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "round tie CA 10.00")
    add("STATE=OH\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 6.00\n",
        "round tie OH 6.00")

    # 17. Error cases
    add("TYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: missing STATE")
    add("STATE=CA\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: missing TYPE")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: missing PAYMENT")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: missing SHIP_METHOD")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: missing SHIP_ZONE")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\n",
        "error: no items")
    add("STATE=ZZ\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: unknown state")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=business\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: unknown type")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=bitcoin\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: unknown payment")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=teleport\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: unknown shipping")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=0\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: zone 0")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=9\nITEM general 1 10.00\n",
        "error: zone 9")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general -1 10.00\n",
        "error: neg qty")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 -10.00\n",
        "error: neg price")

    # 18. Error priority: multiple errors
    add("TYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=bitcoin\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general -1 10.00\n",
        "error priority: missing STATE before others")
    add("STATE=ZZ\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\n",
        "error priority: no items before unknown state")

    # 19. ACH negative surcharge
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=ach\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 1 100.00\n",
        "ACH surcharge")

    # 20. Multi-item orders
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 20.00\nITEM food 3 10.00\n",
        "multi-item general+food CA")
    add("STATE=PA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 20.00\nITEM clothing 3 10.00\n",
        "multi-item general+clothing PA")
    add("STATE=WA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM general 5 20.00\nITEM medicine 3 10.00\n",
        "multi-item general+medicine WA")

    # 21. Medicine in WA (taxed) vs other states (exempt)
    add("STATE=WA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM medicine 1 10.00\n",
        "medicine WA taxed")
    add("STATE=CA\nTYPE=retail\nPAYMENT=cash\nSHIP_METHOD=standard\nSHIP_ZONE=1\nITEM medicine 1 10.00\n",
        "medicine CA exempt")

    # 22. Random combination cases (~300)
    for i in range(300):
        s = rng.choice(STATES)
        t = rng.choice(TYPES)
        p = rng.choice(PAYMENTS)
        sm = rng.choice(SHIP_METHODS)
        z = rng.choice(ZONES)
        cat = rng.choice(CATEGORIES)
        qty = rng.choice([1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 10, 11, 15, 25, 49, 50, 51, 60, 100])
        price = rng.choice([1.00, 5.00, 10.00, 15.00, 20.00, 25.00, 30.00, 50.00, 100.00, 250.00, 500.00])
        c = rng.choice(COUPONS)
        coupon_line = f"COUPON={c}\n" if c else ""
        te = rng.choice(["", "TAX_EXEMPT=false\n", "TAX_EXEMPT=true\n"])
        inp = (f"STATE={s}\nTYPE={t}\n{te}PAYMENT={p}\nSHIP_METHOD={sm}\n"
               f"SHIP_ZONE={z}\n{coupon_line}ITEM {cat} {qty} {price:.2f}\n")
        add(inp, f"random_{i}")

    return cases
<<<END>>>
